text: HAD/C17  Annex B to Appendix VI  2027 年鄉郊一般選舉填寫方格表須知      民政事務總署會就2027 年鄉郊一般選舉，以彩色印製候選人簡介，載有每位候選人在選票上的編 號、候選人的彩色照片、姓名、年齡、職業、電郵地址／網址，及由每位候選人擬備與其選舉信息或參選相關的文字或插圖。此簡介會寄給有關鄉郊地區每位選民參閱，同時，候選人簡介的放大版本將於投 票日在投票站張貼，以供選民參閱。    如何填寫方格表  2.  如候選人擬在候選人簡介上印上其資料1，請按照下文的指示，小心填報夾附的方格表，填報的資料 將會以直接複製方式付印。候選人只可將填報資料填寫在民政事務總署提供的方格表上，任何自行複製／修改的方格表或任何超越方格表藍線範圍的圖文均不會被接受。    (a) 在方格表有關候選人個人資料的文字須為黑色，並用打字機打出、電腦打印機印出或用幼細原子筆以清楚字體填寫。若候選人選用其他顏色填寫，有關文字均會被轉為黑色，印刷效果將會較差。    (b) 請填寫候選人的中文及英文姓名（除非不適用）。候選人可選擇是否提供其他資料（照片、年齡2、職業、電郵地址／網址及選舉信息）。為免引起混亂，如候選人提供的資料（例如職業及電郵地址）與提名表格上所載的資料有所抵觸，有關資料可能不會刊於候選人簡介內。    (c) 候選人的彩色照片必須顯示候選人臉部的正面，及不大於50 x 40 毫米（2 x 15/8 英吋）。照片背景 必須無任何裝飾，顏色為白色、淺藍色或淺粉紅色，請勿採用螢光色或漸變色作背景。照片應為最近6 個月內所拍攝。為達到較佳的印刷效果，我們建議候選人選用沖曬相紙，並避免以噴墨式或鐳射打印機印出照片。民政事務總署保留調整照片影像的權利。除於方格表上指定位置貼上照片外， 請另外交付2 張相同的彩色照片，並在每張照片背面貼上夾附的標貼及填上候選人的中文及英文姓名（除非不適用）及參選的鄉事委員會和鄉郊地區名稱。候選人若填寫電子方格表，所使用的照片 檔案格式必須為JPEG，由掃描器(600dpi)擷取的相片大小為50 毫米(高) x 40 毫米(闊)；如使用由數碼相機擷取的圖像大小最少1600 像素(高) x 1200 像素(闊)。另外，候選人不應上傳經掃描器擷 取的電子方格表，以免降低照片的質素。    (d) 在「選舉信息」標題下的藍線範圍內的資料可包括與其選舉信息或參選相關的任何資料、支持政黨或團體的徽號及詳情等。如所含資料包括其支持政黨或團體的徽號或詳情，候選人應事先獲得該政 黨或團體所給予的書面同意。所用語文、字數、插圖及顏色不限。然而，候選人應注意，部份選民可能只懂中文或英文，而他們同樣有權知悉上述資料。如「選舉信息」內附加標誌或插圖，請盡量 以線條或簡單方式表達，令印刷效果較為清晰。如方格表上「選舉信息」一欄未有填上任何資料，候選人簡介上的選舉信息範圍內將印上「候選人並未提供有關資料」字句。    (e) 如方格表內容含有中文及英文以外的語言，候選人須附上該部份內容的中文或英文翻譯，以確保該部份內容只載有與候選人參選這次選舉相關的物料（有關譯文不會刊於候選人簡介內）。    (f) 如有查詢，請致電鄉郊代表選舉的查詢熱線21521521。遞交方格表  3.  填妥的方格表連同與在方格表上相同的另外2 張彩色照片（每張照片的背面須如上述第2(c)段的要求貼上候選人的中文及英文姓名及參選的有關鄉事委員會和鄉郊地區名稱的標貼），須於候選人遞交提 名表格時或提名期結束前(即於2026 年12 月7 日下午5 時或之前)，一併遞交予選舉主任。如候選人未 能在上述限期前遞交照片及／或與其選舉信息或參選相關的文字或插圖，有關資料將不會刊於候選人簡介 內。 候選 人亦 可透 過鄉 郊代 表選 舉電 子表 格上 載平 台 (https://rrevoter.had.gov.hk/remis/ESubmissionPlatformDS.jsp?lang=tc) 遞交電子方格表，候選人必須細閱本須知及方格表內的內容及說明，確保填妥及簽署電子表格；而候選人仍須將2 張與在電子方格表上相 同的彩色照片在提名期結束前親身交付予選舉主任。    4. 候選人須確保所填報的資料為完整及準確。提名期結束後，選舉主任及民政事務總署不會接納任何更改或提交補充資料的要求。候選人簡介自我介紹短文的內容、性質和闡述方式，純屬候選人的個人構 思及創作。除非有任何內容被認為淫褻、不道德、不合乎體統、令人反感、有誹謗性、屬非法、或載有與宣傳候選人參選無關的資料，否則民政事務總署不會對其內容作出任何改動或增刪。    1 如候選人未有遞交方格表，候選人簡介只會印上候選人的姓名及其在選票上的候選人編號，並在選舉信息範圍內印上「候選人並未提供有關資料」字句。    2 請用阿拉伯數字填寫年齡。

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: HAD/C17  2027 RURAL ORDINARY ELECTION  GUIDE ON COMPLETION OF GRID PAPER    The Home Affairs Department (HAD) will prepare a full colour Introduction to Candidates for the 2027 Rural Ordinary Election. This leaflet will carry the  candidate number as shown on the ballot paper, colour photograph, name, age, occupation and email address/website of each candidate, together with a text or an illustration  provided by each candidate relating to his/her electoral message or candidature. The leaflet will be sent to each elector of that Rural Area, while an enlarged copy of the  Introduction to Candidates will be displayed at the polling station on the polling day for electors’ easy reference.  How to Complete the Grid Paper  2.  A candidate who wishes to have his/her particulars printed on the Introduction to Candidates1 should carefully fill in the attached grid paper in accordance  with the instructions detailed below. The grid paper will be directly reproduced for printing. A candidate can only fill in the particulars on the grid paper provided by  the HAD. Any photocopied or revised grid paper or anything placed outside the blue-lined area on the grid paper will NOT be accepted.  (a)  The personal particulars shown on the grid paper MUST be in black, and typed, printed by computer or hand-written in clear font with a FINE ball pen. If  the grid paper is completed with a colour other than black, the colour of the relevant text will be converted to black with a poorer printing effect.  (b)  The name of the candidate in both Chinese and English should be filled in (unless not applicable). Candidate may opt to provide other personal particulars  (photograph, age2, occupation, email address/website and electoral message). To avoid confusion, information provided by the candidate, such as  occupation and email address, might not be printed on the Introduction to Candidates if it is inconsistent with the information stated in the nomination form.  (c)  The colour photograph of the candidate must be taken full face and not larger than 50mm x 40mm (2 x 15/8 inches) in size. The photograph must have a  plain background in colour of white, light blue or light pink. Background with fluorescent or gradient colours should not be used. The photograph should  be taken within the last 6 months. For better printing quality, the candidate is recommended to use photofinishing paper. Photographs printed by inkjet or  laser printer should be avoided. The HAD reserves the right to adjust the image on the photograph. The photograph should be affixed to the specified  position on the grid paper and another 2 identical copies of colour photographs should be submitted with the attached label supplied affixed to the back of  each copy and the name of the candidate in Chinese and English (unless not applicable) and the name of the Rural Committee and Rural Area in which the  candidate contests written thereon. When the candidate completes the electronic grid paper, the photograph type must be in JPEG format. If captured by  scanner (600dpi), the photograph size is 50mm(H) x 40mm(W). If captured by digital camera, the image size is at least 1600px(H) x 1200px(W). Besides,  the candidate should not upload the electronic grid paper captured by scanner, so as to avoid lowering the quality of the photograph.  (d)  The type of information to be included inside the blue-lined area on the grid paper below the caption “Electoral Message” may include any information  relating to the electoral message or candidature of the candidate, emblem and particulars of the supporting political party or organization, etc. If any emblem  or particulars of the supporting political party or organization is/are included, the candidate should ensure that prior written consent of the party or organization  concerned has been obtained. There is no restriction on the language, number of words, illustrations and colour to be used. However, the candidate should  note that some electors may only be familiar with either the Chinese or English language and they are equally entitled to be informed of the above information.  Any logo or illustrations to be included under “Electoral Message” should preferably be in line work or simple presentation for better image quality on  reproduction. If the field for “Electoral Message” on the grid paper is left blank, the words “Relevant information has not been provided by the candidate”  will be printed in the space provided for electoral message on the Introduction to Candidates.  (e)  If the grid paper contains any content in a language other than Chinese and English, the candidate should enclose the translation of such content in Chinese  or English in order to ensure that it contains materials relating only to his/her candidature of the candidate at this Election (the translation will NOT be  included in the Introduction to Candidates).  (f)  For enquiries, please call the enquiry hotline of the Rural Representative Election at 21521521.  Submission of Grid Paper  3.  The completed grid paper together with 2 additional colour photographs of the candidate which are identical to the one affixed to the grid paper (with the  label supplied affixed to the back of each copy and the name of the candidate in Chinese and English and the name of the Rural Committee and Rural Area in which the  candidate contests written thereon as required in paragraph (2)(c) above) should be submitted to the Returning Officer at the time of submitting the nomination form or  before the end of the nomination period (i.e. on or before 5 pm, 7 December 2026). If the photographs and/or the text or illustration relating to the electoral message or  candidature are not submitted before the said deadline, the relevant information will NOT be included in the Introduction to Candidates. The candidate may submit the  electronic grid paper through the Rural Representative Election e-Submission Platform (https://rrevoter.had.gov.hk/remis/ESubmissionPlatformDS.jsp?lang=en). The  candidate should read this Guide together with the notes and content of the grid paper, and ensure the e-Form is duly completed and signed. Also, the candidate should  submit the 2 identical colour photographs as the one attached on the electronic grid paper to the Returning Officer in person by the end of nomination period.  4. The candidate should ensure the completeness and accuracy of the information provided. The Returning Officer and the HAD will not accept any request  for correction or addition to the grid paper made after the end of nomination period. The contents, nature and presentation of a candidate’s message in the Introduction  to Candidates are exclusively the idea and creation of the candidate himself/herself. They will not be subject to alteration or editing by the HAD unless they are considered  to be obscene, immoral, indecent, offensive, defamatory, unlawful, or contain information not relating to the promotion of the candidature of the candidate concerned.    1 If a candidate does not submit the grid paper, the Introduction to Candidates will only show the name of the candidate and his/her candidate number as shown on the  ballot paper, and the words “Relevant information has not been provided by the candidate” will be printed in the space provided for electoral message.    2 The age should be completed in Arabic numerals.

text: Dear Candidate,    2027 Rural Ordinary Election  Notes to Candidates    1.  Your nomination form has been received by the Returning Officer. Please note that your  eligibility and the validity of subscribers are pending further verification, subject to  whether all requirements set out in sections 22, 23 and 24 of the Rural Representative  Election Ordinance (Cap.576) (“RREO”) are being met. According to section 7(3) of the Electoral Procedure (Rural Representative Election)  Regulation (Cap.541L), the Returning Officer may require a candidate to furnish any other  information that he/she considers necessary in order to satisfy himself/herself as to the  eligibility of the candidate or the validity of the nomination.    3. Validly nominated candidates attend the candidates’ briefing  session.    15. Attend the lots drawing session held by the RO for the  contested Rural Areas to determine the candidate number or  the order of appearance to be shown on the ballot paper and  the designated spots allocated for the display of EAs.      16. Receive from the RO the permission/authorisation for the  display of EAs at designated spots allocated to the candidate  (candidates for uncontested Rural Areas will not be allocated  with designated spots).    Around 14 days after  the end of nomination  period  17. Check the ballot paper printing proof and verify the  particulars relating to the candidate to be printed on the ballot  paper. If a candidate or his election agent cannot perform  the checking in person, the candidate may authorise a  representative in writing to check the particulars concerned  on the ballot paper printing proof on his behalf.    (If a candidate or his election agent/authorised representative  does not perform the checking at the date and venue  specified by the HAD, the printing proof of the ballot paper  will be adopted for printing without further notice.)

For details, please refer to the “Notes on Using the Rural Representative Election e- Submission Platform”.    5. 由於劃一格式選舉捐贈收據（HAD/C2）必須作為選舉開支及接受選舉捐贈之申報書及聲明書（HAD/C1）或接受 選舉捐贈預先申報書及聲明書（HAD/C18）的附件一併提交，其提交方式是視乎相關表格的要求而定。  As “Standard Receipt for Election Donations” (HAD/C2) must be submitted as an attachment with “Return and Declaration  of Election Expenses and Election Donations” (HAD/C1) or “Advance Return and Declaration of Election Donations”

text: (HAD/C18), its submission methods depend on the requirements of the respective forms.    6. 在發布任何選舉廣告後的3 個工作天（即公眾假期及星期六以外的任何1 天）內，如候選人打算以印本形式呈交選舉廣告作公眾查閱，候選人必須向有關的選舉主任呈交每個選舉廣告的文本2 份，以及1 份與該選舉廣告相關的資料摘要、支持同意書及／或在私人物業展示選舉廣告或進行競選活動的批淮書。至於實際上不能或不便以同 樣方式出示的選舉廣告，候選人則須呈交每個選舉廣告一式2 份的全彩色相片／打印本／影印本及1 份相關的 資料摘要、支持同意書及／或在私人物業展示選舉廣告或進行競選活動的批淮書。候選人必須確保遞交的選舉廣告詳情符合《選舉程序（鄉郊代表選舉）規例》（第541L 章）第92 條及《鄉郊代表選舉活動指引》第七章的章節的規定及要求。  If a candidate provides election advertisements in a hard copy format for public inspection, he/she must provide the relevant  Returning Officer with 2 copies each of the election advertisements together with 1 copy of the information sheet, Consent  of Support and/or permission for display of election advertisements or conduct of electioneering activities at private  premises within 3 working days (i.e. any day other than a general holiday and Saturday) after publication of any election  advertisements. In respect of the election advertisements which cannot be practically or conveniently produced in specie,  2 identical full colour photos/printouts/photocopies of each election advertisement together with 1 copy of the information  sheet, Consent of Support and/or permission for display of election advertisements or conduct of electioneering activities  at private premises must be provided. The candidate must ensure that the election advertisement particulars submitted  comply with the rules and requirements as set out in section 92 of the Electoral Procedure (Rural Representative Election)  Regulation (Cap.541L) and Chapter 7 of the “Guidelines on Election-related Activities in respect of the Rural  Representative Election”.    7. 欲申請中央平台戶口的候選人須將填妥的中央平台戶口申請表及有關候選人使用中央平台的條款及細則的承諾書（HAD/C10a）的正本送交民政事務總署署長。  A candidate who would like to apply for an account of the Central Platform should provide the original of the completed  Application for Creating an Account of the Central Platform and Undertaking in respect of the Terms and Conditions in  Using the Central Platform for Candidates (HAD/C10a) to the Director of Home Affairs.    8. 任何進入投票站、選票分流站或點票站的人士（包括候選人、選舉代理人、監察投票代理人、監察點票代理人、 選舉主任、助理選舉主任、負責投票、選票分流或點票的工作人員、及任何獲授權人士）須在進入投票站、選票 分流站或點票站時攜同此保密聲明，並於有需要時親自出示以供檢查。  Every person (including candidates, election agents, polling agents, counting agents, Returning Officers, Assistant  Returning Officers, officers on polling, ballot paper sorting or counting duties and any other authorized persons) attending  a polling station, a ballot paper sorting station or a counting station should bring this Declaration of Secrecy when entering  a polling station, a ballot paper sorting station or a counting station and produce it in person for inspection whenever  required.    9. 如候選人或選舉代理人希望使用選民資料，他們須向選舉主任一併提供已簽署的「索取選民資料通知書」和「正確使用選民資料承諾書」。承諾書必須以正本提供。若候選人或選舉代理人以電郵或傳真提供表格，他們可在親 身領取選民資料時簽署承諾書。他們須在2027 鄉郊一般選舉後兩星期內把選民資料的硬複本及／或軟複本，以 及從上述複本複製的選民個人資料妥善銷毀；以及於上述限期前把「確認已妥善銷毀選民資料的回條」填妥並交回有關的選舉主任。倘若候選人或選舉代理人未能於上述選舉後兩星期內向選舉主任交回有關回條，候選人或選 舉代理人須將事件向香港個人資料私隱專員公署及有關執法部門（例如香港警務處）報告。  If candidates/their election agents would like to use electors’ information, they must provide the signed “Notice for  Collection of Electors’ Information” with the signed “Undertaking on the Proper Use of Electors’ Information” to the  Returning Officer. The original of the Undertaking must be provided. If candidates/their election agents provide the  forms by e-mail or facsimile, they can sign the Undertaking when they collect the electors’ information in person. They  should duly destroy the hard copy and/or soft copy of the electors’ personal data copied from the aforesaid copies within  two weeks after the 2027 Rural Ordinary Election, and return the duly completed “Reply Slip on Confirmation of  Destruction of the Elector’s Information” to the relevant Returning Officer before the above deadline. If the candidate or  the election agent fails to return the relevant Reply Slip to the Returning Officer within two weeks after the above election,  the candidate or election agent should report the incident to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data,  Hong Kong and the relevant law enforcement agencies (e.g. the Hong Kong Police Force).

text: 10. 候選人應親身或透過電子表格上載平台遞交方格表予有關的選舉主任。額外兩張相同的照片需放回塑料袋中並親 身交回有關的選舉主任。  Candidates can submit the grid paper in person or via e-Submission Platform to the relevant Returning Officer. The two  additional identical photographs should be put back into the PVC bag and returned in person to the relevant Returning  Officer.    11. 《選舉程序（鄉郊代表選舉）規例》（第541L 章）第22(3B)及37(1C)條列出有關選舉代理人及監察投票代理人 在位於監獄內的專用投票站內停留的申請之規定。如申請／委任通知是在投票日前一星期內發出的，懲教署署長仍可根據該款給予同意，前提是懲教署署長信納－  (a)  在投票日前一星期內，有某名有權在位於監獄內的專用投票站投票的受羈押選民被收入或轉往該監獄；及  (b)  在該名選民被如此收入或轉往該監獄後，有關申請／委任通知在沒有無故拖延的情況下，在該星期內根據 該款交付，則署長可應該申請而根據該款給予同意。  Sections 22(3B) and 37(1C) of the Electoral Procedure (Rural Representative Election) Regulation (Cap.541L) stipulate  the requirements for applying for the presence of election agent and polling agent in a dedicated polling station situated in  a prison. If an application / a notice of appointment is given during the week before the polling day, the Commissioner of  Correctional Services may still give consent under that subsection if the Commissioner is satisfied that –  (a) an elector in custody who is entitled to vote at a dedicated polling station situated in a prison is admitted or transferred  to the prison during that week; and  (b) the application / the notice of appointment is made without undue delay after the admission or transfer.

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: 12. 提交選舉代理人、監察投票代理人及監察點票代理人的委任通知書的方式概述如下，以供參考：  The submission methods of notice of appointment for election agent, polling agent(s) and counting agent(s) are summarized below  for reference –    選舉代理人  Election Agent  (HAD/C6)  投票日之前  Before the polling day  委任通知書可藉專人送遞、電子郵件、電子方式、圖文傳真或郵遞方式交付予有關鄉郊地區的選舉主任。  The notice of appointment may be delivered by hand, by electronic mail, by electronic  submission, by facsimile transmission or by post to the relevant Returning Officer for the  rural area.    投票日  On the polling day  委任通知書可藉專人送遞、電子郵件、電子方式或圖文傳真交付予有關鄉郊地區的選舉主任。  The notice of appointment may be delivered by hand, by electronic mail, by electronic  submission or by facsimile transmission to the relevant Returning Officer for the rural area.    監察投票代理人  Polling Agent  (HAD/C7)  投票日前的第7 天或之前  At least 7 days before the polling  day  委任通知書可藉專人送遞、郵遞、電子郵件、電子方式或圖文傳真方式交付予有關鄉郊地區的選舉主任。  The notice of appointment may be delivered by hand, by post, by electronic mail, by electronic  submission or by facsimile transmission to the relevant Returning Officer for the rural area.    投票日  On the polling day  非位於懲教院所內的投票站  委任通知書可由候選人或其選舉代理人親自交付予該投票站的票站主任。  For a polling station not situated in a penal institution  The notice of appointment may be delivered by the candidate or his/her election agent in  person to the Presiding Officer of the polling station.    監察點票代理人  Counting Agent  (HAD/C8)  投票日前3 天之前  Before 3 days preceding the  polling day  委任通知書可藉專人送遞、郵遞、電子郵件、電子方式或圖文傳真方式交付予有關鄉郊地區的選舉主任。  The notice of appointment may be delivered by hand, by post, by electronic mail, by electronic  submission or by facsimile transmission to the relevant Returning Officer for the rural area.

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: 投票日  On the polling day  委任通知書可由候選人或其選舉代理人親自交付予有關監察點票代理人所負責的點票站／選票分流站的票站主任／選舉主任／助理選舉主任（視屬何情況而定）。  The notice of appointment may be delivered by the candidate or his/her election agent in  person to the Presiding Officer/Returning Officer/Assistant Returning Officer of the  counting station/ballot paper sorting station for which the counting agent is appointed (as the  case may be).

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: 13. 提交選舉代理人、監察投票代理人及監察點票代理人的撤銷委任通知書的方式概述如下，以供參考：  The submission methods of notice of revocation of appointment for election agent, polling agent(s)and counting agent(s) are  summarized below for reference –    選舉代理人  Election Agent  (HAD/C9)  投票日之前  Before the polling day  撤銷委任通知書可藉專人送遞、電子郵件、電子方式、圖文傳真或郵遞方式交付予有關鄉郊 地區的選舉主任。  The notice of revocation may be delivered by hand, by electronic mail, by electronic submission, by  facsimile transmission or by post to the relevant Returning Officer for the rural area.    投票日  On the polling day  撤銷委任通知書可藉專人送遞、電子郵件、電子方式或圖文傳真方式交付予有關鄉郊地區的 選舉主任。  The notice of revocation may be delivered by hand, by electronic mail, by electronic submission or  by facsimile transmission to the relevant Returning Officer for the rural area.    監察投票代理人  Polling Agent  (HAD/C9)  投票日之前  Before the polling day  撤銷委任通知書可藉專人送遞、電子郵件、電子方式、圖文傳真或郵遞方式交付予有關鄉郊 地區的選舉主任。  The notice of revocation may be delivered by hand, by electronic mail, by electronic submission, by  facsimile transmission or by post to the relevant Returning Officer for the rural area.    投票日  On the polling day  非位於懲教院所內的投票站  撤銷委任通知書可—  (a)  由候選人或其選舉代理人親自交付予該投票站的票站主任；或  (b)  藉專人送遞、電子郵件、電子方式或圖文傳真方式交付予有關鄉郊地區的選舉主任。  For a polling station not situated in a penal institution  The notice of revocation may be delivered—  (a)  by the candidate or his/her election agent in person to the Presiding Officer of the polling  station; or  (b)  by hand, by electronic mail, by electronic submission or by facsimile transmission to the  relevant Returning Officer for the rural area.  位於懲教院所內的專用投票站撤銷委任通知書可藉專人送遞、電子郵件、電子方式或圖文傳真方式交付予有關鄉郊地區的選舉主任。  For a dedicated polling station situated in a penal institution  The notice of revocation may be delivered by hand, by electronic mail, by electronic submission or  by facsimile transmission to the relevant Returning Officer for the rural area.

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: 監察點票代理人  Counting Agent  (HAD/C9)  在投票日之前  Before the polling day  撤銷委任通知書可藉專人送遞、電子郵件、電子方式、圖文傳真或郵遞方式交付予有關鄉郊地區的選舉主任。  The notice of revocation may be delivered by hand, by electronic mail, by electronic  submission, by facsimile transmission or by post to the relevant Returning Officer for the  rural area.    投票日（投票結束前）  On the polling day (before the  close of the poll)  撤銷委任通知書可—  (a)  由候選人或其選舉代理人親自交付予點票站主管；或  (b)  藉專人送遞、電子郵件、電子方式或圖文傳真方式交付予有關鄉郊地區的選舉主任。  The notice of revocation may be delivered—  (a)  by the candidate or his/her election agent in person to the Officer-in-charge of the  relevant counting station;  (b)  or by hand, by electronic mail, by electronic submission or by facsimile transmission to  the relevant Returning Officer for the rural area.    投票日（投票結束後）  On the polling day (after the close  of the poll)  撤銷委任通知書可由候選人或其選舉代理人親自交付予有關監察點票代理人所負責的點票站／選票分流站的票站主任／選舉主任／助理選舉主任（視屬何情況而定）。  The notice of revocation may be delivered by the candidate or his/her election agent in person  to the Presiding Officer/Returning Officer/Assistant Returning Officer of the counting  station/ballot paper sorting station for which the counting agent is appointed (as the case may  be).

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: 遞交選舉廣告至中央平台的程序指引   Procedural Guide on Submission of Election Advertisements onto the Central Platform  本程序指引是根據《鄉郊代表選舉活動指引》 第七章及附錄四有關遞交選舉廣告及有關資料擬定。  This procedural guide is provided for the submission of election advertisements (“EAs”) and relevant information in  accordance with Chapter 7 and Appendix 4 of the “Guidelines on Election-related Activities in respect of the Rural  Representative Election”.  I.  申請開立中央平台戶口   Application for an Account on the Central Platform  參考 / 表格  Reference / Form  (1) 候選人在使用中央平台遞交選舉廣告前，請將已填妥的表格「中央平台戶口申請表及有關候選人使用中央平台的條款及細則的承諾書」（表格編號： HAD/C10a）（「申請表」）送交民政事務總署署長。候選人可在鄉郊代表選舉 網頁下載最新版本的申請表：  http://www.had.gov.hk/rre    填妥的申請表，可藉以下方式送交民政事務總署署長：  專人送遞或郵遞（地址：香港灣仔軒尼詩道130 號修頓中心30 樓）；電子郵件（電郵地址：rre@had.gov.hk）；或圖文傳真（傳真號碼：25916392）。    A candidate should provide the Director of Home Affairs (“DHA”) with the completed  form “Application for Creating an Account of the Central Platform and Undertaking in  respect of the Terms and Conditions in Using the Central Platform for Candidates”  (Form no.: HAD/C10a) (“Application Form”) before he/she can access the Central  Platform to provide any EA particulars. Candidate may download the latest version of  the Application Form from website of Rural Representative Election –  http://www.had.gov.hk/rre    The duly completed application may be delivered to the Director of Home Affairs by  the following methods –  by hand or by post (Address: 30th Floor, Southorn Centre, 130 Hennessy Road, Wan  Chai, Hong Kong);  by electronic mail (Email Address: rre@had.gov.hk); or  by facsimile transmission (Fax no.: 25916392).    (2) 民政事務總署署長會於收到申請表的3 個工作天內，將用戶名稱透過電郵發送至 候選人提供的電郵地址。而兩個登入密碼則會以短訊發送至候選人提供的手提電話號碼。  Upon receipt of the Application Form, the DHA will inform the candidate within 3  working days of the username through the email address provided by the candidate.  Two login passwords will be sent by short message service (“SMS”) to the mobile phone  number provided by the candidate.    HAD / C10a    Appendix XI

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 2        II. 登入中央平台  Login to Central Platform  參考 / 表格  Reference / Form  (1) 連接至中央平台的超連結如下：  The hyperlink for accessing the Central Platform is as below –  https://www1.eaplatform.had.gov.hk/bd_hadea/logon  (2) 第一次登入中央平台時，請使用由民政事務總署署長提供的用戶名稱及密碼。  To log in to the Central Platform for the first time, please use the username and the  passwords provided by the DHA.  (3) 請於第一次登入中央平台後更改密碼。  Please change the passwords after the first login.  (4) 如候選人忘記登入密碼，請在中央平台按指示輸入電郵地址（必須跟申請表上的電郵地址相同）及按照版面指示輸入驗證碼作核證，以重設密碼。  系統在收到重設密碼指令後，會自動重設兩個新密碼。系統將透過候選人提供的手機號碼以短訊通知已更改的新密碼，同時亦會透過電郵通知有關 密碼已被更改。  If a candidate forgets the passwords, please follow the instruction on the Central  Platform by inputting the email address (must be identical to the one provided in the  Application Form) and inputting the verification code according to the instruction on  screen for verification in order to reset the passwords.  The system will automatically generate two passwords upon receipt of the instruction  of resetting passwords. The new passwords will be sent via SMS to the mobile phone  number provided by the candidate. A notification on changing passwords will also be  sent to the candidate by email.    附件一  Annex A  III. 使用中央平台的電腦配備要求  Technical Configuration for the use of the Central Platform    我們建議候選人使用最新版本的Mozilla Firefox、Safari 或 Google Chrome 的瀏覽器瀏覽本系統網頁，以獲最佳效果。若候選人仍然使用舊版本，請更新至最新版 本。候選人亦可使用其他瀏覽器登入中央平台。如有任何技術問題，請致電鄉郊代表選舉的查詢熱線 21521521。  For the best viewing of the webpages in this system, candidates are suggested to use  the latest version of Mozilla Firefox, Safari or Google Chrome. If a candidate is using  the older version of a browser, please update it to the latest version. A candidate may  also use other web browsers to log in to the Central Platform. If any technical issue  arises, please call the enquiry hotline of the Rural Representative Election at 21521521.

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 3        IV. 遞交選舉廣告及有關資料 (包括准許∕授權文件)  Submission of EA(s) and Relevant Information (including Permission/Authorization  Document)  參考 / 表格  Reference / Form  (1) 登入中央平台後，請在主目錄按「遞交新選舉廣告」，並選擇選舉廣告的種類、輸入選舉廣告的相關詳情，並夾附相關的檔案或連結。如須遞交另一個選舉廣告，請按「新增另一選舉廣告」及重覆有關步驟。  After logging in to the Central Platform, please click from the menu “Submit New  Election Advertisement(s)”, then click on a type of EA, fill in all EA particulars, attach  the relevant file/link of the concerned EA. If another EA is to be submitted, please click  “Add Another Election Advertisement” and repeat the steps to provide another EA.  (2) 完成輸入選舉廣告詳情後，請按「預覽」檢視將要遞交的資料及檔案（註：就已上載的檔案，版面只顯示有關檔案的名稱）。如須更正任何資料，請按「返回」 回到之前的步驟。  After inputting the EA particulars, please click “Preview” to check the particulars and  file before submission (Note: For the uploaded files, only the file names will be shown  on the screen). If correction to any particulars is required, please click “Back” to go  back to the previous step.  (3) 若所有將要遞交的資料正確，請按「遞交」以上載選舉廣告。每次成功上載後，螢幕會顯示一份確認回條，而有關成功上載選舉廣告的訊息亦會透過電郵和短訊 發送至申請表上提供的電郵地址和手提電話號碼。  If all particulars to be provided are in order, please click “Submit” to upload the EA.  Upon each successful uploading, an acknowledgement of receipt will be shown on the  screen and a note on the successful uploading of EA will be sent via email and SMS to  the email address and the mobile phone number provided in the Application Form.  (4) 候選人可以在遞交選舉廣告的資料時，一併上載適用於該項選舉廣告的准許／授權文件。  Candidate may upload the permission/authorization documents applicable to the EA  together with the submission of EA particulars.          附件二 / 樣本一  Annex B / Sample I

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 4        V. 遞交同意書文件  Submission of Consent Document(s)  參考 / 表格  Reference / Form  (1) 在主目錄按「遞交同意書文件」，然後選擇同意書類型（即新增的同意書或撤銷之前遞交的同意書） 及夾附同意書的檔案。如須遞交另一份同意書，請按「新增另一同意書文件」及重覆有關步驟。  Click “Submit Consent Document” on the main menu, then select a type of consent (i.e.  to add a new consent or revoke a previous provided consent) and attach the file. Please  click “Add another Consent Document” and repeat the steps to provide another  consent.  (2) 完成選擇同意書的檔案後，請按「預覽」，以檢視將要遞交的同意書清單（註：螢幕上只顯示有關同意書檔案的名稱）。如須更正任何錯漏，請按「返回」回到 之前的步驟。  After completion of the selection of the consent file(s), please click “Preview” to view  the list of consents before submission (Note: Only the file names of the consents will  be shown on the screen). If correction to any errors/omissions is required, please click  “Back” to go back to the previous step.  (3) 若所有將要遞交的同意書正確，請按「遞交」以上載同意書。每次成功上載後，螢幕會顯示一份確認回條，而有關成功上載同意書的訊息亦會透過電郵和短 訊分別發送至申請表上提供的電郵地址和手提電話號碼。  If all consent(s) to be provided is/are in order, please click “Submit” to upload the  consent(s). Upon each successful uploading, an acknowledgement of receipt will be  shown on the screen. A note on the successful uploading of consent(s) will be sent via  email and SMS to the email address and the mobile phone number provided in the  Application Form.                  附件三  Annex C

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 5        VI. 修正選舉廣告詳情  Correction of EA Particulars  參考 / 表格  Reference / Form  (1) 如須修正已上載至中央平台的任何選舉廣告資料，請在主目錄按「修正已遞交的選舉廣告」，然後按「遞交日期」、「遞交編號」及「項目」的下拉式選單以選 擇須修正的選舉廣告。如候選人欲查閱所有曾上載的選舉廣告，請按「如須查閱曾上載的選舉廣告，請按此連結」的超連結。   If correction to any EA particulars already uploaded onto the Central Platform is  required, please click “Correct Submitted Election Advertisement(s)” on the main  menu. Then, click the pull-down menu of “Submission Date”, “Submission Number”  and “Item” to select the EA to be corrected. If a candidate would like to check the  particulars of all EA submitted, please click the hyperlink “For Checking Submitted  Election Advertisement(s), Please Click Here”.   (2) 完成選擇須修正的選舉廣告後，請在有關項目的欄位輸入正確的選舉廣告資料及／或夾附正確的檔案／連結以修正相關的選舉廣告。  註︰只須在需要修正的項目填寫正確的資料，而不須重新填寫其他無需修正的項目。  After selecting the EA to be corrected, please fill in the correct EA information in the  text box of the relevant item and/ or attach the correct file/link to correct the related  EA.  NOTE: Only the particulars of the item to be corrected are required to be filled in.  There is no need to fill in the particulars of other items which do not need to be  corrected.  (3) 完成輸入須修正的選舉廣告資料後，請按「預覽」檢視將要遞交的資料。如須進一步修正任何資料，請按「返回」回到之前的步驟。  After inputting the EA particulars to be corrected, please click “Preview” to check the  particulars before submission. If further correction to any particulars is required,  please click “Back” to go back to the previous step.  (4) 若所有將要遞交的資料正確，請按「遞交」以上載已修正的選舉廣告資料。每次成功上載後，螢幕會顯示一份確認回條，而有關上載修正的選舉廣告的訊息亦會 透過電郵和短訊發送至申請表上提供的電郵地址和手提電話號碼。  If all EA particulars to be provided are in order, please click “Submit” to upload the  corrected EA particulars. Upon each successful uploading, an acknowledgement of  receipt will be shown on the screen. A note on the successful correction of EA  particulars will be sent via email and SMS to the email address and the mobile phone  number provided in the Application Form.  附件四 / 樣本二  Annex D / Sample 2

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 6        注意 Note  (1) 候選人須在選舉申報書內申報所有載於中央平台的已發布的選舉廣告所招致的選舉開支。詳情請參閱 「選舉開支及接受選舉捐贈之申報書及聲明書指南」。  All election expenses incurred for the published EAs contained in the Central Platform should be declared in  the Election Return provided by the candidates. Please refer to the “Guide to Return and Declaration of  Election Expenses and Election Donations” for details.  (2) 候選人應盡量安排上載方便有需要人士（例如視障人士）讀取之電腦檔案至中央平台。此外，候選人 可瀏覽網頁https://www.digitalpolicy.gov.hk/tc/our_work/digital_government/digital_government/  digital_inclusion/accessibility/，參閱有關無障礙網頁的資訊。  Candidates are encouraged to make arrangement such that the files uploaded onto the Central Platform are  accessible to persons in need (e.g. persons with visual impairment) as far as possible. Candidates may obtain  information on web accessibility from the website https://www.digitalpolicy.gov.hk/en/our_work/  digital_government/digital_inclusion/accessibility/.  (3) 候選人在上載選舉廣告及有關資料（包括准許∕授權文件）或同意書至中央平台前，請先將文件內所有個人資料如身分證明文件號碼及電話號碼（如有）遮蓋。  Before uploading the EA and relevant information (including permission/authorization document) or consents  onto the Central Platform, please cover all personal data such as identity document numbers and telephone  numbers (if any) on the documents.  (4) 如候選人將發布選舉廣告的網頁超連結上載至中央平台，他／她須確保該超連結有效及有關網頁持續 運作直至選舉申報書的文本根據《選舉（舞弊及非法行為）條例》（第 554 章）第41 條可供查閱的 期間結束為止，以便公眾查閱選舉廣告。  If a candidate uploads the hyperlink of a website on which an EA is published onto the Central Platform, he/she  must ensure the hyperlink is valid and the relevant website continues to operate until the end of the period  for which copies of election returns are available for inspection pursuant to section 41 of the Elections  (Corrupt and Illegal Conduct) Ordinance (Cap.554), so as to facilitate public inspection of the EAs.  查詢Enquiry  有關使用中央平台提交選舉廣告文本及相關文件的查詢，可致電鄉郊代表選舉的查詢熱線21521521。  For enquiries related to submission of copies of EAs and related documents through the Central Platform,  please call the enquiry hotline of the Rural Representative Election at 21521521.

text: Page 15        Annex B 附件二步驟二  •  請按「廣告類型」的下拉式選單選擇廣告種類。如該選單未有提供適合的選舉廣告分類，你可選擇「其他（請註明）」及輸入資料（例如：帽／肩帶等）。    •  請按「發布日期」，然後選擇日期。按「製作／印製日期」，然後選擇日期。輸入發布的文本數目、製作／印製的文本數目、尺寸／面積、製作人／印刷人的姓名、發布方式及製作人／印刷人的地址。    註：所有項目均必須填寫；如某些項目不適用於某個選舉廣告，請在該項目填上「不適用」。此外，就所有選舉廣告印刷品（刊登在本港註冊報刊上的選舉廣告除外），候選人必須披露其印刷人的完整地址，例如印 刷人的辦事處或業務地址、通訊地址、住址或郵政信箱號碼 （但不包括電郵地址），並不可只提供部分地 址。上述要求亦適用於候選人自行在家中印刷的選舉廣告。  Step 2  •  Click the pull-down menu of “EA Type” and choose a type of EA. For EAs that cannot be classified as any one of  the types specified on the menu, please select “Others (Please Specify)” and key in the details (e.g. Cap/Sash, etc.).    •  Click “Date of Publication” and select the date. Fill in the  number of copies published, number of copies produced/printed, size/dimension, the name of producer/printer,  the manner of publication and the address of producer/printer”.    Note：All fields must be filled-in; please input “N/A” for item(s) which is/are not applicable to a particular EA.  In addition, for all printed EAs (except those printed in the registered local newspapers), candidates must  disclose their printer's address in full, for examples, printer’s office or business address, correspondence  address, residential address, or post office box number (but not including email address), and cannot only  provide part of the address. text: Page 17        Annex B 附件二步驟三  •  請在「廣告檔案／連結」選擇「檔案」或「連結」以上載選舉廣告或輸入連結。如該選舉廣告是以檔案方式儲存（例如xxx.jpeg 或yyy.pdf 等類別），請先選擇「檔案」並按「瀏覽」，然後從你的電腦選擇需 上載的選舉廣告檔案；如該選舉廣告是屬於互聯網的連結（例如:www.xxx.blog.hk/poster），請先選擇 「連結」，然後輸入該選舉廣告連結。    •  如在發布該選舉廣告時須取得相關准許／授權，請按「准許／授權文件」旁的「瀏覽」，以便上載該准許／授權的文件。請遮蓋表格內所有個人資料，例如身分證明文件號碼及電話號碼（如有的話）。    •  如須遞交的某一選舉廣告或准許／授權文件涉及多於一個檔案，請將檔案以Zip 檔（.zip）、RAR 檔（.rar）或GNU zip 檔（.gz）壓縮至單一檔案以供上載。    •  在完成輸入一個選舉廣告所須的資料及夾附檔案／連結後，如須遞交另一個選舉廣告，請按「新增另一個選舉廣告」及重複有關步驟。    •  請採用下列表一的檔案格式夾附檔案。    Step 3  •  Please choose “File” or “Link” under “EA File/Link” to upload the EA or fill in the link. If the EA is saved as a file  (e.g. xxx.jpeg or yyy.pdf, etc.), please click “File” and “Browse” to select the corresponding file from your computer  for uploading; if the EA is a webpage link, (e.g. www.xxx.blog.hk/poster), please click “Link” and fill in the particular  webpage link of the EA.    •  If permission/authorization is required for publication of the EA, please click “Browse” next to “Permission/  Authorization Document” to upload the particular permission/authorization document. Please cover all personal  data such as identity document numbers and telephone numbers (if any) on the permission/authorization  document.    •  If more than one file is involved in submitting a particular EA or permission/authorization, please compress the  files into one single file by using file format of either Zip (.zip), RAR (.rar) or GNU zip (.gz) before uploading.    •  After filling in the requested information and attaching the relevant file/link for one EA, please click “Add another  Election Advertisement” and repeat the steps to provide another EA.    •  Please attach files in the file formats as shown in Table 1 below.

text: Page 19        Annex B 附件二步驟四  •  完成輸入選舉廣告詳情後，請按「預覽」檢視將要遞交的資料及檔案（註：就已上載的檔案，版面只顯 示有關檔案的名稱）。如須更正任何資料，請按「返回」回到之前的步驟。    •  若所有將要遞交的資料正確，請按「遞交」上載選舉廣告資料。請注意：根據選舉法例及指引，候選人須在發布選舉廣告後的3 個工作天內，把與選舉廣告有關的資料／文件，包括准許／授權或支持同意書，上載至中央平台或候選人平台或向選舉主任提供印本式文本，以供公眾查閱。    Step 4  •  After inputting the EA particulars, please click ‘Preview’ to review the particulars and file before the submission  (Note: For the uploaded files, only the file names will be shown on the screen). text: Page 23        Annex C 附件三步驟三  •  每次成功上載後，螢幕會顯示一份確認回條；請按「列印」打印出確認回條；或按「儲存」將有關確認回條儲存於你的電腦。而有關成功上載同意書的訊息亦會透過電郵及短訊發送至申請表上提供的電郵地 址及手提電話號碼。  •  如未能在確認回條中顯示成功上載某一同意書的記錄，請重新遞交該同意書。    Step 3  •  Upon each successful uploading, an acknowledgement of receipt will be shown on the screen. Please click “Print”  to print out the acknowledgement, or click “Save “to save the acknowledgement in your computer. A note on the  successful uploading of consent(s) will also be sent via email and SMS to the email address and the mobile phone  number provided in the Application Form.  •  If the acknowledgement of successful uploading of a consent is not shown, please provide that consent again.                          按「列印」打印出確認回條。  Click “Print” to print out the  acknowledgement.  按「儲存」將有關確認回條儲存於你的電腦。  Click “Save” to save the acknowledgement in your computer.

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 24        Annex D 附件四第四部分：修正選舉廣告詳情  Section D: Correction of EA Particulars    步驟一  •  請在主目錄按「修正已遞交的選舉廣告」。  •  請按「遞交日期」及「遞交編號」的下拉式選單，選擇須修正的選舉廣告，然後按「下一步」。如候選人欲查閱所有曾上載的選舉廣告，請按「如須查閱曾上載的選舉廣告，請按此連結」的超連結。  •  請按「項目」的下拉式選單選擇須修正的選舉廣告。  Step 1  •  Please click “Correct Submitted Election Advertisement(s)” on the main menu.  •  Click the pull-down menu of “Submission Date” and “Submission Number” to select the EA to be corrected, then  click “Next”. If candidates wish to check the particulars of all EAs provided, please click the hyperlink “For  Checking Submitted Election Advertisement(s), Please Click Here”.  •  Click the pull-down menu of “item” to select the EA to be corrected.      按「修正已遞交的選舉廣告」。  Click “Correct Submitted Election  Advertisement(s)”.

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 26        Annex D 附件四步驟二  •  完成選擇須修正的選舉廣告後，請在有關項目的欄位輸入正確的選舉廣告資料及／或夾附正確的檔案／ 連結以修正相關的選舉廣告。  •   如須要於同一遞交日期及遞交編號的上載記錄中修正另一個選舉廣告，請按「修改另一選舉廣告」並重覆以上步驟。註：就須修正的選舉廣告詳情（例如:製作／印製的文本數目及／或夾附的檔案／連結有錯誤），你只需於該 欄目填寫正確的資料及／或夾附正確的檔案／連結。假若其他選舉廣告的資料及／或檔案或連結的資料並無 錯誤，你便無須重新輸入之前已上載的資料。    Step 2  •  After selecting the EA to be corrected, please fill in the correct EA information in the text box of the relevant item  and/or attach the correct file/link to correct the relevant EA.  •  If correction to another EA among the uploaded records of the same submission date and submission number is  required, please click “Correct another Election Advertisement” and repeat the above steps.  Note: For the EA particulars to be corrected (e.g. errors in the number of copies to be produced/printed and/or  file/link attached), you are only required to fill in the correct information for that particular item and/or attach the  correct file/link. You are not required to fill in other items if no error is found in other EA particulars/file/link  previously provided.

If further correction  to any particulars is required, please click “Back” to go back to the previous step.  •  If all EA particulars to be provided are in order, please click “Submit” to upload the corrected EA particulars.          按「預覽」檢視輸入資料詳情。  Click “Preview” for details of information  inputted.  如資料正確，按「遞交」。  Click “Submit” if all particulars to be provided are in order.

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 29         Annex D 附件四步驟四  •  每次成功上載後，螢幕會顯示一份確認回條，請按「列印」打印出確認回條；或按「儲存」將有關確認回條儲存於你的電腦。而有關成功上載修正的選舉廣告的訊息亦會透過電郵及短訊發送至申請表上提供 的電郵地址及手提電話號碼。  •  如未能在確認回條中顯示成功上載某一項修正的記錄，請重新遞交該修正。註：就已修正的選舉廣告詳情，你需確保原有的選舉廣告的連結仍然有效或上載該截圖，以供公眾查閱。  Step 4  •  Upon each successful uploading, an acknowledgement of receipt will be shown on the screen. You can then click  “Print” to print out the acknowledgement; or click “Save” to save the acknowledgement in your computer. A note  on successful correction of EA particulars will also be sent via email and SMS to the email address and mobile  phone number provided in the Application Form.  •  If the acknowledgement of successful uploading of a correction of EA particulars is not shown, please provide the  correction again.    Note: For the EA particulars which have been corrected, you are required to ensure the link to the original EA  is still accessible or you may upload the relevant screenshot for public inspection.      按「列印」打印出確認回條。  Click “Print” to print out the  acknowledgement.  按「儲存」將有關確認回條儲存於你的電腦。  Click “Save” to save the acknowledgement in your computer.

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 30        Sample 1 樣本一遞交選舉廣告的例子  Examples on Submission of Election Advertisement (“EA”)    事例（一） Case 1  候選人於12 月21 日共印製300 份傳單並在12 月22 日（假設12 月22 日為星期日）於街頭派發其中100 張傳 單。  候選人須於12 月27 日（即首次發布該選舉廣告後的3 個工作天內（12 月25 及26 日為公眾假期））或之前透 過中央平台遞交選舉廣告詳情，並夾附選舉廣告的檔案或連結。有關選舉廣告詳情應參照例1.1 的方式填寫。    A candidate printed 300 copies of handbills in total on 21 December and distributed 100 copies of the handbills on the  street on 22 December (assuming 22 December is a Sunday).  The candidate is required to provide the EA particulars via the Central Platform, together with the file/link of the EA by 27  December (i.e. within 3 working days after the date on which the EA is first published (25 and 26 December are public  holidays)), and EA particulars should be filled in as shown in Example 1.1.    例Example 1.1

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 31        Sample 1 樣本一若候選人於12 月23 日再派發其餘200 張，候選人須於12 月28 日（12 月25 及26 日為公眾假期）或之前透過 中央平台遞交選舉廣告詳情。這次的遞交應被視為一次新的選舉廣告詳情，而選舉廣告詳情應參照例1.2 的方式填寫。    If the candidate distributed the remaining 200 copies of handbills on 23 December, he/she had to provide the EA  particulars via the Central Platform by 28 December (25 and 26 December are public holidays). The submission would be  regarded as a new submission and the EA particulars should be filled in as shown in Example 1.2.    例Example 1.2

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 32        Sample 1 樣本一事例（二）Case 2  候選人於12 月21 日共印製300 份海報，並於12 月23 日於某鄉村共20 間商鋪張貼該海報。候選人須於12 月28 日（12 月25 及26 日為公眾假期）或之前透過中央平台遞交選舉廣告詳情及有關商鋪的准許 ／授權文件的電子文本。有關選舉廣告詳情應參照例2.1 的方式填寫。如有多於一份准許／授權文件，候選人可 將所有文件壓縮為一個檔案（如Zip）再上載至中央平台。    A candidate printed 300 copies of poster in total on 21 December and displayed one poster at each of 20 shops in a certain  village on 23 December.    The candidate is required to provide the EA particulars and an electronic copy of the prior permission/authorization  documents issued by the relevant shops via the Central Platform by 28 December (25 and 26 December are public  holidays). The EA particulars should be filled in as shown in Example 2.1. If there are more than one  permission/authorization received from the relevant shops, candidate should compress all documents into a single file  (e.g . Zip) before uploading onto the Central Platform.    例Example 2.1

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 33        Sample 1 樣本一事例（三） Case 3  候選人於12 月22 日自製一份電子版的海報，並將有關電子海報透過以下的電子方式發布。候選人在中央平台遞交選舉廣告資料時可參考以下例子：    (1) 如候選人將電子海報在同日於一個或多於一個的社交媒體發布（例如：Facebook、Instagram 等），他 ／她須於 12 月 27 日（12 月25 及26 日為公眾假期）或之前將選舉廣告詳情提供至中央平台，並提供 該選舉廣告的連結（只發布於一個社交媒體適用，請參考例3.1）或檔案（發布於多於一個社交媒體 適用，請參考例3.2），供公眾查閱。請注意，若候選人選擇提供選舉廣告的連結，他／她須提供該選舉廣告的連結而不是社交媒體的連結。但是，若候選人於同日另以電郵及 WhatsApp 等形式將該電 子海報傳送給100 位支持者，由於發布的方式不同，應被視為發布新的選舉廣告，該候選人須另行將 選舉廣告詳情提供至中央平台，並提供該選舉廣告的連結／檔案，供公眾查閱（請參考例 3.3）。    A candidate created an electronic copy of a poster on 22 December and published it via the following electronic means.  The candidate may make reference to the following examples when submitting EA particulars onto the Central Platform  –    (1) If the candidate published the electronic poster via one or more than one social media on the same date (e.g.  Facebook, Instagram etc.), he/she is required to provide the EA particulars onto the Central Platform,  attaching the link (EA published on one social media only, Example 3.1 refers) or file (EA published on more  than one social media, Example 3.2 refers) of the EA, for public inspection by 27 December (25 and 26  December are public holidays). If the candidate chooses to provide the link of the EA, he/she is required to  provide the link of the EA instead of the social media. However, if the candidate also sent the electronic poster  to 100 supporter(s) via electronic mail and WhatsApp etc. on the same date, it should be regarded as  publishing a new EA as the poster was published in a different manner. As such, that candidate is required to  provide the EA particulars to the Central Platform, with the file/link of the EA attached, for public inspection  separately (Example 3.3 refers).

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 37        Sample 2 樣本二修正選舉廣告的例子  Examples on Correction of an EA    事例（四） Case 4  候選人於12 月21 日共印製300 張傳單，並於12 月22 日於街頭派發所有傳單，候選人已於12 月22 日透過中央平台遞交選舉廣告詳情。惟候選人其後發現派發的傳單數量應為80 張，而非先前上載的100 張。    在此情況下，候選人須最遲於投票日後3 個工作天內透過中央平台修正該選舉廣告詳情。候選人只須填寫須修改的項目，而無須重新填寫其他並不需要修正的項目。有關修正資料應參照例4.1 的方式填寫。    A candidate printed 300 copies of handbills in total on 21 December and distributed all of them on 22 December. The  candidate provided the EA particulars via the Central Platform on 22 December. However, the candidate later found that  the number of handbills distributed should be 80 instead.    In that case, the candidate has to correct such EA particulars via the Central Platform not later than 3 working days after  the polling day. The candidate should only fill in the information to be corrected and does not need to fill in other item(s)  which no correction is required. The correction should be done as shown in Example 4.1.    例Example 4.1

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 38        Sample 2 樣本二事例（五） Case 5  候選人於12 月21 日共印製300 份海報並在12 月22 日於街頭派發其中100 張，候選人已於12 月22 日透過中央平台遞交選舉廣告詳情。惟候選人其後發現印刷人的地址出錯。在此情況下，候選人須最遲於投票日後3 個工作天內透過中央平台修正該選舉廣告詳情。候選人只須填寫須修改的項目，而無須重新填寫其他並不需要修正的項目。有關修正資料應參照例5.1 的方式填寫。    The candidate printed 300 copies of posters in total on 21 December and distributed 100 copies of the posters on the  street on 22 December. The candidate provided the EA particulars via the Central Platform on 22 December. However,  the candidate later found that the address of printer was not correct.    In this case, the candidate has to correct such EA particulars via the Central Platform not later than 3 working days after  the polling day. The candidate should only fill in the information to be corrected and does not need to fill in other item(s)  which no correction is required. The correction should be done as shown in Example 5.1 below.    例Example5.1

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 39        Sample 2 樣本二事例（六）Case 6  候選人於12 月21 日共印製300 張傳單，並於12 月22 日於街頭派發其中100 張。候選人已於12 月22 日透過中 央平台遞交選舉廣告詳情。惟候選人其後發現12 月22 日於街頭派發的傳單數目應修正為50 張，而餘下50 張已 於12 月23 日以郵寄方式分發。在此情況下，  (1) 候選人須先於中央平台修改於12 月22 日上載的派發選舉廣告的詳情，即將街頭派發的傳單數目由100 改為 50，有關修正資料應參照例6.1 的方式填寫。    A candidate printed 300 copies of handbills in total on 21 December and distributed 100 copies of the handbills on the  street on 22 December. The candidate provided the EA particulars via the Central Platform on 22 December. However,  the candidate later noticed that the number of handbills distributed on the street on 22 December should be 50 instead,  and the remaining 50 were distributed on 23 December by post.    In that case,  (1) the candidate is required to correct on the Central Platform the EA particulars distributed on 22 December by  changing the number of handbills distributed on the street from 100 to 50. The correction should be done as shown  Example 6.1.    例Example 6.1

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 40        (2) 餘下50 張於12 月23 日以郵寄方式分發的傳單，由於分發的日期及方式不同，應被視為發布新的選舉廣告。 候選人應於12 月28 日（12 月25 及26 日為公眾假期）或之前，透過中央平台遞交新的選舉廣告詳情及上載 該郵寄單張的電子文本，並非進一步修正之前已上載的選舉廣告詳情。遞交新的選舉廣告詳情的方式應參照例6.2 的方式填寫。    (2) Regarding the remaining 50 handbills distributed by post on 23 December, they should be regarded as publishing a  new EA for the handbills were distributed in a different manner. Instead of further correcting the EA particulars  provided previously, the candidate is required to provide new EA particulars and upload an electronic copy of the  handbills sent by post via the Central Platform by 28 December (25 and 26 December are public holidays) in respect  of such handbills distributed by post. The new EA particulars should be filled in as shown in Example 6.2.    例Example 6.2

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 41        事例（七）Case 7    候選人於12 月21 日共印刷300 張傳單，並於12 月22 日派發。候選人已於12 月23 日透過中央平台遞交選舉廣 告詳情。惟候選人其後發現錯誤上載另一張傳單的電子文本。在此情況下，候選人須最遲於投票日後3 個工作天內透過中央平台修正該選舉廣告詳情，重新上載正確的傳單的電子文本。有關修正資料應參照例7.1 的方式填寫。    A candidate printed 300 copies of handbills in total on 21 December and distributed them on 22 December. The candidate  submitted the EA particulars via the Central Platform on 23 December. However, the candidate later found that he/she  had wrongly uploaded the electronic copy of another handbill.    In this case, the candidate has to submit via the Central Platform by uploading the electronic copy of the correct handbill  not later than 3 working days after the polling day. The correction should be done as shown in Example 7.1.    例Example 7.1

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 42        事例（八）Case 8  (1) 候選人於12月21日製作10 張沒有加上候選人編號的橫額，於12月22日在路邊欄杆展示。候選人須於12月27日（12月25及26日為公眾假期）或之前將選舉廣告詳情上載中央平台。有關選舉廣告詳情應參照例8.1 的方式填寫。    (1) A candidate produced 10 banners without candidate number on 21 December and displayed them on roadside railing  on 22 December. The candidate is required to provide the EA particulars onto the Central Platform by 27 December  (25 and 26 December are public holidays). The EA particulars should be filled in as shown in Example 8.1.    例Example 8.1

title: 運作手冊附錄 I–XVI（2026年10月，英文）
text: Page 43        (2) 候選人其後於12月30日在橫額貼上候選人編號標貼。雖然候選人編號標貼本身不會被視為一份選舉廣告，但 候選人曾就原有的選舉廣告作出修改。因此候選人須最遲於投票日後 3 個工作天內，透過中央平台上載已貼 上編號標貼之選舉廣告的電子文本，以修正已遞交的選舉廣告詳情。有關修正資料應參照例8.2的方式填寫。    (2) Subsequently, the candidate stuck candidate number stickers on the banners on 30 December. Though the candidate  number sticker is not an EA itself, the original EA was amended by the candidate. Therefore, the candidate is required  to correct the EA particulars provided previously by uploading the electronic copy of the EA with stickers on it via the  Central Platform, not later than 3 working days after the polling day. text: Page 6        Section C: Request Removal of an EA File/Link    According to section 94 of Cap.541L, any unauthorized or offending EAs displayed  may be seized, disposed of, destroyed, covered or obliterated by the RO or any  person authorized by him/her as he/she thinks fit. As the Central Platform is  maintained by the HAD HQs, please refer to the following procedures in putting  up request in removing a particular EA file/link from the public inspection page as  and when required (while other EA particulars such as date of publication,  manner of publication, etc., will continue to be shown to the public).    Step 1: The RO should seek DoJ’s advice before making a decision on removing an  EA file/link.    Step 2: If removal of EA file/link is required, the RO should inform the candidate(s)  concerned by signing the Notice of Decision as to Removal of Election  Advertisement (HAD/R24).    Step 3: The RO should then complete and sign personally on a Request Form  (HAD/R23) and attach the Notice to candidate to authorize and request the HAD  HQs (Attn.: PM(1)7) to remove the EA file/link concerned.    Step 4: The PLO(1)2 will, upon receipt of the request, take appropriate removal  action and inform the RO upon completion of the removal action.    Note: If the concerned EA file/link is on the Candidate’s Platform, the RO should  also seek DoJ’s advice and if removal of EA file/link is required, the RO should  notify the candidate(s) concerned by signing the Notice of Decision as to Removal  of Election Advertisement (HAD/R24) and copy the Notice to the HAD HQs.

text: HAD/R19  (鄉村／墟鎮名稱)選舉主任    (選舉主任地址)  Returning Officer for   (Name of the Village/Market Town)    (Address of the Returning Officer)  本函檔號 OUR REF:  來函檔號 YOUR REF:  電話Tel：圖文傳真Fax：致：(鄉村/墟鎮名稱)各候選人    二零二七年鄉郊一般選舉拆除在禁止拉票區內展示的選舉廣告通知書        2027 年鄉郊一般選舉的*村代表選舉╱街坊代表選舉將於2027 年1 月 XX 日(投票日日期)舉行，每個投票站將在投票日設有禁止拉票區。現隨函夾附投票站禁止拉票區的位置圖，以供參考。    根據《選舉程序(鄉郊代表選舉)規例》（第541L章）第35(2)條及《鄉郊代表選舉活動指引》第七章及十三章，在投票站範圍(包括投票站所處樓宇的外牆)或禁止拉票區內，均不准展示任何選舉廣告，經選舉主任或有關投票站的票站主任授權的非流動性展示品除外(這類非流動性展示品，主要指由票站主任在投票站外展示由民政事務總署印製的候選人簡介單張的放大本，以及展示於選舉主任編配的"指定展示位置"內的選舉廣告(如有的話))。請你於2027年1月XX日(投票日日期)前，拆除任何展示在禁止拉票區內的私人樓宇的選舉廣告(如有的話)。請注意，若候選人於投票日當天仍未拆除該等選舉廣告，選舉主任會向候選人發出警告，著其立刻拆除違規的選舉廣告。倘若候選人沒有依從，選舉管理委員會將作出譴責或嚴厲譴責。    請注意，根據《鄉郊代表選舉活動指引》附錄五，「展示可移動的廣 告，包括在車輛上（不論車輛是在禁止拉票區內行駛或停放），或由人手持這 些展示品」亦屬嚴禁在禁止拉票區內進行的拉票活動。因此，若你曾安排在公 共服務車輛（例如小巴、的士）的車窗或車身上展示選舉廣告，而該等車輛會 於投票日在禁止拉票區內行駛或停放，你亦應確保該等選舉廣告在2027年1月 XX日(投票日日期)前已經移除，以免觸犯在禁止拉票區內進行拉票活動的禁制。如對上述內容有任何疑問，請致電(電話號碼)與(聯絡人姓名)聯絡。       (鄉村／墟鎮名稱)選舉主任     (XXX 代行)  連附件    20XX 年X 月XX 日

title: 選舉主任指明／標準表格 HAD/R2–R26（2026年10月，英文）
text: HAD/R19    (鄉村／墟鎮名稱)選舉主任    (選舉主任地址)  Returning Officer for  (Name of the Village/Market Town)    (Address of the Returning Officer)  本函檔號 OUR REF:  來函檔號 YOUR REF:  電話Tel：圖文傳真Fax：  (XX XXX 20XX)  To: All candidates of (Name of Village/Market Town)    2027 Rural Ordinary Election  Notice on Removal of Election Advertisements (“EAs”)  Displayed within No Canvassing Zone (“NCZ”)        The *Village Representative Election/Kaifong Representative Election of 2027  Rural Ordinary Election will be held on XX January 2027 (Date of Election). An area  outside each polling station will be designated as an NCZ on the polling day. The location  plan of NCZ for the polling station is enclosed for your reference.    According to section 35(2) of the Electoral Procedure (Rural Representative  Election) Regulation (Cap.541L) and Chapters 7 and 13 of the Guidelines on Election- related Activities in respect of the Rural Representative Election, no EA may be displayed  within the boundaries of a polling station (including the outer walls of the premises) or  within any NCZ, except for static displays that are authorized by the Returning Officer  (“RO”) or the Presiding Officer (“PRO”) of the relevant polling station (this kind of static  displays mainly refers to the enlarged copy of the relevant introductory leaflets on  candidates published by the Home Affairs Department to be displayed outside the polling  station by the PRO, and EAs displayed at designated spots within NCZ which are allocated  by the RO, if any).    Please remove all EAs, if any, displayed at the private premises within the NCZ on  the polling day before XX January 2027 (Date of Election). Please note that if a  candidate fails to remove those EAs, the RO may issue a warning to him/her to remove the  offending EAs immediately. If the candidate fails to do so, the Electoral Affairs  Commission may issue a censure or reprimand.    Please note that according to Appendix 5 of the Guidelines on Election-related  Activities in respect of the Rural Representative Election, “exhibition of portable displays on  vehicles (whether in motion or parked within the area), or held or carried by persons” is also  regarded as a canvassing activity forbidden within an NCZ. Therefore, if you have  arranged for the display of EAs on the windows or bodywork of any public service vehicles  (e.g. minibuses, taxis), and those vehicles will pass through or be parked within the NCZ on  the polling day, you should ensure that those EAs are removed before XX January 2027  (Date of Election), in order to avoid contravention of the prohibition of canvassing activities  in the NCZ.    Should you have any enquiries on the above, please contact (contact person’s name)  at (telephone no.).    Encl.   (XXX)  for Returning Officer for (Name of the Village/Market Town)

Submission of Return and Declaration of Election Expenses and Election  Donations    According to section 37 of the Elections (Corrupt and Illegal Conduct)  Ordinance (Cap.554) (the Ordinance), a candidate at the Rural Representative Election  must submit to the Director of Home Affairs (DHA) the Return and Declaration of  Election Expenses and Election Donations (the Election Return) (Form no.: HAD/C1)  within the statutory period, unless extension of the period has been allowed by the  Court under section 40 of the Ordinance. A candidate who fails to comply with the  requirement commits an offence and on conviction is liable to a fine of $200,000 and  to imprisonment for 3 years.    To comply with the statutory requirement, please complete the Election Return  and submit it to DHA via the Returning Officer on or before 1 March 2027. Even  if no election expenses were incurred nor any election donations received, you are still  required to complete and submit the Election Return.      The Home Affairs Department will check the Election Return and any cases  where irregularities, e.g. errors, omissions, understatements, miscalculations,  unreasonable expenses, apparent breaches of the law, etc., are found will be referred to  the Independent Commission Against Corruption. title: 選舉主任指明／標準表格 HAD/R2–R26（2026年10月，英文）
text: HAD/R25  2027年鄉郊一般選舉遞交候選人提名表格注意事項    1.  提名表格可於新界各區民政事務處及民政事務總署(香港灣仔軒尼詩道130號修頓中心30樓)免費索取，亦可於鄉郊代表選舉網頁(www.had.gov.hk/rre)下載。    2.  提名期為2026年11月24日至12月7日（包括首尾兩天），選舉主任接受提名的時間為星期一至星期五上午九時至下午五時及星期六上午九時至中午十二時。候選人須於提名期內遞交他／她的提名表格，逾時遞交將不會受理。    3.  候選人須親自遞交提名表格給有關鄉郊地區的選舉主任。如候選人因事（如提名期間不在港或生 病等）未能親自遞交提名表格，須得到選舉主任的同意才可以由指定的代表代為遞交表格。有關 申請須清楚列明候選人的姓名及所屬鄉郊地區、未能親自遞交提名表格的原因（如有文件證明， 請一併提供）、擬指定的代表的姓名及香港身分證號碼（必須與香港身分證相符），並透過傳真 (傳真號碼：25916392)或電郵(電郵地址：rre@had.gov.hk)經鄉郊選舉組轉交選舉主任。    4.  候選人應盡早遞交提名表格，以便於提名期結束前，將提名表格上可能發現的錯處更正。    5.  遞交提名表格不設預約，選舉主任辦事處將按候選人遞交提名表格的先後次序處理有關提名表格。    6.  由於選舉主任辦事處地方有限，每名候選人只可以由一名隨行人士陪同遞交提名表格(即包括候 選人在內不多於兩人)。    7.  在選舉主任接受提名的時候，所有進入選舉主任辦事處或在場的人士必須遵守下列規則及聽從選 舉主任或獲其授權人士的指示：  (a)  為確保選舉主任辦事處內的公眾安全，任何人士均不可攜帶、使用或展示任何選舉主任或獲 其授權人士認為可能對在場人士造成滋擾、不便、騷擾、妨礙、障礙或危險的物品（包括但不僅限於行李、頭盔、揚聲器、發聲物品）、或任何形式的宣傳品（包括橫額、彩旗）進入選舉主任辦事處。  (b)  嚴禁在選舉主任辦事處內喧嘩、叫囂或作出任何滋擾他人的行為。  (c)  嚴禁在選舉主任辦事處內吸煙、飲食、拍照、錄音／錄影或直播／轉播。  (d)  進入選舉主任辦事處或在場的人士不可故意阻塞任何入口或出口，或妨礙、阻塞、或惡意影 響選舉主任辦事處外的行人流動或車輛交通。  (e)  無人認領的物品會由保安人員、選舉主任或獲其授權人士或警方處理，不作事先通知。  (f)  如有任何擾亂秩序的即時威脅及／或違反香港法例的行為，警方或會適當地作出執法行動。    8.  選舉主任或獲其授權人士會要求任何不遵守上述規則或違反選舉主任或獲其授權人士指示的人士立即離開選舉主任辦事處。    9.  選舉主任及／或民政事務總署保留隨時更改此《注意事項》的權利。  10. 如有任何查詢，請致電鄉郊代表選舉熱線 21521521。民政事務總署  2026年10月

title: 選舉主任指明／標準表格 HAD/R2–R26（2026年10月，英文）
text: HAD/R25  2027 Rural Ordinary Election  Points to Note for Submission of Nomination Forms for  Candidates    1.  Nomination form is available free of charge at the New Territories District Offices and the Home  Affairs Department (“HAD”) at 30/F, Southorn Centre, 130 Hennessy Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong.  It can also be downloaded from the Rural Representative Election website (www.had.gov.hk/rre).    2.  The nomination period will run from 24 November 2026 until 7 December 2026 (both days inclusive),  and the Returning Officers (ROs) will receive nominations between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. from  Monday to Friday and between 9:00 a.m. and 12:00 noon on Saturday. Candidate must submit  his/her nomination form within the nomination period. Late submission will not be accepted.    3.  Candidate must submit his/her nomination form in person to the RO for the relevant Rural Area. If  a candidate cannot submit the nomination form in person (e.g. because of the candidate’s temporary  absence from Hong Kong or incapacity due to illness), he/she must obtain the RO’s authorization to  submit the nomination form by a designated representative. The application shall clearly state the  name of the candidate and the Rural Area concerned, the reason for not being able to submit the  nomination form in person (with documentary proof if available), and the full name and Hong Kong  Identity Card number of the proposed representative (as shown on the Hong Kong Identity Card).  The application should be submitted to the RO via the Rural Election Team by fax (fax no.: 2591  6392) or by e-mail (email address: rre@had.gov.hk).    4.  Candidate is strongly advised to submit his/her nomination form as early as practicable so that any  mistakes found in his/her nomination form can be rectified before the end of the nomination period.    5.  Prior appointment is not available for submission of nomination forms. The nomination forms will  be handled by the RO’s office on a first-come-first-served basis.    6.  Due to limited space in the RO’s office, each candidate shall only be accompanied by one  companion during submission of the nomination form (that is, not more than two persons with the  candidate included).    7.  In the course of receiving a nomination form by the RO, all persons present at or entering the RO’s  office must observe the following rules and follow the instructions of the RO or his/her authorized  officers:  (a) To ensure public safety at the RO’s office, no person shall bring into, use or display in the  RO’s office any article which RO or his/her authorized officers consider(s) that may cause  nuisance, inconvenience, disturbance, interference, obstruction or danger to other persons  (including but not limited to, luggage, helmet, loudhailers, sound emitting objects) or  publicity materials of any kind (including banners, bunting flyers).  (b) Shouting, yelling or any activities that would cause nuisance to other parties are prohibited in  the RO’s office.  (c) Smoking, eating, drinking, photo-taking, sound/video-recording and live/relay broadcast are  prohibited in the RO’s office.  (d) Persons entering or present at the RO’s office shall not deliberately cause obstruction at points  of entry or exit, nor shall they impede, obstruct or detrimentally affect the flow of pedestrians  or traffic outside the office.  (e) Found property will be handled by security staff, RO or his/her authorized officers or the  Police without further notice.  (f)  Should there be any imminent threat of a breach of the peace and / or any act contrary to the  Laws of Hong Kong, enforcement action may be taken by the Police as they see fit.

text: 1.6. To facilitate effective and efficient communication, the contact  numbers of relevant parties are provided at Appendix II for your  quick reference.    Note The contact numbers of relevant parties should be for  internal use only and should not be disclosed to the  public.    Ss.78 and 79 of Cap.541L stipulate that an RO, ARO,  PRO, polling officer or counting officer who, in an  election for which he or she is appointed, may not act  as an agent* or shall not be an employee of a  candidate.    RO/ARO should pay special attention to these  provisions to avoid committing any act which  contravenes the above provisions.      * An agent includes an election agent, a polling agent, a counting agent and an election expense agent.    ^ Following the established practice, for KFR Election, the RO(s) appointed for the relevant Market  Towns will be required to determine the validity of questionable ballot papers; for VR Election, the  determination will be made by the relevant PROs appointed for the respective Villages.
